description: T183 — 1D fluid two-component SIDM mass segregation (A2, 2026-09-21)
method: 1D spherical fluid approximation. Heavy component segregates inward at rate ~ (sigma_HL/sigma_0) * (m_H - m_L)/m_H * t. Initial conditions: equal fractions of NFW profile.

Yang_2025_params.note: Yang+ used 2800x larger cross-section than Phase 44

verdict: Mass segregation at Phase 44 cross-sections (0.052 cm^2/g) is WEAKER than Yang+ 2025 (147 cm^2/g). The borrowed f_H profiles (0.85/0.30) are likely an overestimate for our parameter regime. If f_H is actually 0.40 instead of 0.85, Cloud-9 sigma/m drops to ~28, failing the >=50 floor. A full N-body simulation is needed to verify.
